acks.note: The map kit can now trace a country: a bright line with a glowing head runs round its border and closes on the word that names it, then stays lit (flat/map.tsx `trace`); the director now does this for every country a line is about.

Done for every Short, no test: the country a line is about is covered by its own flag (about 60 flags drawn at their true 3:2 shape, checked in stills: India, the UK, France, Germany, Denmark, the USA, Canada, Mexico look right; very thin Chile also gets a planted flag beside it), and named people like Napoleon stand on the map as their photo head.
